scientific.integrity: The upper bound is proved independently of enumeration. Equality cases are exhaustively enumerated from a 74-vertex normalized compatibility graph; the verifier reconstructs the metric by an independent shortest-path route and checks all structural assertions.
scientific.limitations: The result is restricted to S_5 and minimum Cayley distance 3. The stated 28,800-element isometry group is explicit and sufficient for the orbit claim, but is not claimed to be the full isometry group. Literature search leaves a residual risk of an obscure or unindexed finite census.

title: Equality cases for the S_5 Cayley code at distance 3
